# IP camera (`camera`)

Whether an IP camera is up and answering in RTSP. Read-only: the camera is never moved or changed, and the probe sends no credentials.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/camera`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/camera/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/camera/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `camera` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- TCP to the device, port 554

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` | Address | IP address or host name | yes |  | The camera's IP address or host name, such as 192.0.2.30. |
| `port` | RTSP port | port | no | `554` | The camera's RTSP port. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `login` | Login | yes | The camera's login, as user:secret. Stored for viewing; the status probe never sends it. |
